command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first.
# OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 matches upstream's own `compare` script -- thread count must not move a
# result that is being compared against a committed reference.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
NOK=$(sha256sum -c --ignore-missing pins.sha256 2>/dev/null | grep -c ': OK$')
printf 'pinned_files_verified\t%s\n' "$NOK"
test "$NOK" -eq 2 || { echo "FAIL: verified $NOK pinned files, expected 2"; exit 1; }
sed 's/^/  /' expected.tsv

echo "== the running binary must be the version the references came from =="
# A reference from another version is a different number. Read it from the binary, not the lock.
CCX=$(command -v ccx)
test -n "$CCX" || { echo "FAIL: no ccx binary in this image"; exit 1; }
V=$("$CCX" -v 2>&1 | grep -oE 'Version [0-9.]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}')
printf 'ccx_binary\t%s\nccx_version\t%s\n' "$CCX" "$V"
test "$V" = "2.23" || { echo "FAIL: ccx reports $V, the staged suite is ccx_2.23"; exit 1; }

echo "== their comparison script is perl, so perl has to be here =="
command -v perl >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL: perl absent -- datcheck.pl cannot run"; exit 1; }
perl -e 'printf("  perl %vd\n", $^V)'

echo "== unpack =="
tar xjf ccx_2.23.test.tar.bz2
TD=CalculiX/ccx_2.23/test
cp run-suite.sh "$TD"/
cd "$TD"
chmod +x datcheck.pl run-suite.sh
printf 'cases_available\t%s\nreferences_available\t%s\n' "$(ls *.inp | wc -l)" "$(ls *.dat.ref | wc -l)"

echo "== run the suite, compared by CalculiX's own datcheck.pl =="
CCX="$CCX" bash run-suite.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/suite.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

# Copy evidence out BEFORE acting on the exit code, so a failed run is diagnosable.
cp failures-static.txt failures-path.txt timings.tsv /tmp/ 2>/dev/null
grep -E '^(excluded_|static_cases_|path_cases_|suite_wall_s|slowest_case|path_deviations_)' /tmp/suite.log > /tmp/score.tsv.tmp 2>/dev/null

echo "== the canary: achtel2 must reproduce the exact line staging pinned =="
OURS=$(grep -m1 -E '^ *3 +2\.46' achtel2.dat 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ')
REFS=$(grep -m1 -E '^ *3 +2\.46' achtel2.dat.ref | tr -s ' ')
printf 'achtel2_node3_ours\t%s\nachtel2_node3_ref\t%s\n' "$OURS" "$REFS"
test -n "$OURS" || { echo "FAIL: achtel2 produced no node-3 displacement row"; exit 1; }
test "$OURS" = "$REFS" || { echo "FAIL: achtel2 node 3 differs from its committed reference"; exit 1; }

cd /tmp
{ echo -e "observable\tvalue"; cat score.tsv.tmp 2>/dev/null
  printf 'ccx_version\t%s\nachtel2_node3_exact\tyes\n' "$V"; } > score.tsv
cp score.tsv calculix-diag.txt
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: the suite reported failures"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
